Tanah (Borang Elektronik) 2017.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Disember 2017.

Borang elektronik

bentuk elektronik sebagaimana yang ditetapkan dalam Jadual kepada  Kaedah-Kaedah
ini.

LAND ACQUISITION ACT 1960

LAND ACQUISITION (ELECTRONIC FORMS) RULES 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 69 (ba) of the
Land Acquisition Act 1960 [ Act 486 ], the Minister , with the approval of the National
Land Council, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1) These rules may be cited as the Land Acquisition (Electronic Forms)
Rules 2017.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 1 December 2017.

Electronic forms
2. The form s specified in the Second Schedule of the Act, may be prescribed in
electronic form as prescribed in the Schedule of these Rules.

[Rule 2]
